attchmntText: Nova Agritech Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Nova Agritech Limited announced the outcome of its Board meeting held on 14th November 2026. The Board considered and approved the Un-audited Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was 4,594.95 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 152.77 lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.14 rupees. The Consolidated revenue from operations stood at 10,916.86 lakhs, with a profit after tax of 185.64 lakhs. Consolidated earnings per share were 0.20 rupees. The meeting commenced at 12:30 PM and concluded at 02:15 PM. The Limited Review Report by Independent Auditors was also placed before the Board.

attchmntText: Updated Outcome of Board Meeting held on 14.11.2026
voiceSummary: Nova Agritech Limited board approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Standalone revenue from operations was 4,594.95 lakhs. Standalone profit before tax was 435.36 lakhs. Standalone basic earnings per share was 0.23 rupees. Consolidated revenue from operations was 10,916.86 lakhs. Consolidated profit before tax was 337.34 lakhs. Consolidated basic earnings per share was 0.20 rupees. The board meeting was held on 14th November 2026.

attchmntText: Nova Agritech Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Nova Agritech Limited approved un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. The Board meeting was held on 14th November 2026. Standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was 4,594.95 lakhs. Standalone profit before tax was 435.36 lakhs. Standalone earnings per share were 0.23 rupees. Consolidated revenue from operations for the quarter was 10,916.86 lakhs. Consolidated profit before tax was 337.34 lakhs. Consolidated earnings per share were 0.20 rupees. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and the Independent Auditors’ Limited Review Report was placed before the Board.
